text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — I opened a PR to update SOC2 docs language around tenant separation and audit log examples. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123. Need clarity from legal on wording + security on the example events.

samir-docs: Taking a look now. Major changes are in the 'What counts as tenant metadata' section?

elaine: yeah — I tried to split 'audit event' vs 'tenant metadata' with concrete examples. Also added a migration note for customers upgrading from the old audit schema.

samir-docs: Cool. Two quick asks: 1) can you add an explicit example of a redacted audit event, and 2) add a short SDK snippet showing how to call the audit-export endpoint with redaction config?

elaine: Yep. I added a short JSON example and this tiny Node snippet. See the PR diff.

kevin: Example JSON looks fine but suggest using "event_type" instead of "type" to avoid colliding with internal enums. Also include a timestamp format example (ISO8601).

elaine: good call, switching to event_type. Updated snippet in PR.

legal_jane: Quick review from legal side: avoid absolute statements like 'we never store' — prefer 'we do not store customer plaintext secrets as part of audit events' and include retention window language. Can you put an explicit placeholder: '<retention-window> (e.g., 90 days)' so we don't accidentally promise forever?

elaine: ack. I'll replace any absolutes and insert a retention example.

security_ben: From security: please add a note about KMS envelope encryption for exported audit bundles and call out that exported bundles should be stored in customer-controlled storage for Private deployments. Also: add example config key name used in SDK snippet.

elaine: adding. Proposed text for export note: "For Private deployments, customers should configure audit export to a customer-controlled S3 bucket with KMS CMK; Redwood will not retain export copies." Thoughts?

legal_jane: That phrasing is better. Suggest "Redwood will not retain exported copies beyond the configured export retention window" and don't reference 'never' — legal needs the retention window.

samir-docs: I'm pushing a small edit to the examples file right now — fixing the JSON key names and adding a short migration checklist below the snippet.

docs-bot: PR #4123 — CI checks pending. Reviewer request: @legal_jane, @security_ben, @matt.

matt: I can review infra/ops wording. The retention example should show both hosted and private cases. Hosted: 'we retain audit events for <retention-window-hosted> days by default (configurable)'. Private: 'retention is customer-managed'.

elaine: updated PR with hosted vs private bullets and an example migration command for customers using the old audit export tool. Included a fenced code block for the migration command: ```bash
redwood-audit-migrate --source old-audit.json --redact-keys password,ssn --dest new-schema.json
```

kevin: small nit: in the migration snippet add `--concurrency 4` note for performance.

elaine: done.

legal_jane: One more legal nit: in the 'what we collect' table, move 'IP address' to 'tenant metadata (may be PII depending on jurisdiction)' and add a parenthetical: '(subject to region-specific privacy laws)'.

samir-docs: done in docs branch. Also added an inline example of a redacted audit event: ```json
{
  "event_type": "file.upload",
  "timestamp": "2026-11-03T14:12:09Z",
  "actor": "user:alice@example.com",
  "resource": "/datasets/42",
  "details": {
    "file_name": "invoice.pdf",
    "file_hash": "sha256:..."
  },
  "redacted_fields": ["credit_card_number"]
}
```

security_ben: that looks good. Can you also show an SDK snippet for setting a redaction policy? e.g.: ```js
client.audit.setRedactionPolicy({ paths: ["$.details.credit_card_number"], mode: "mask" })
```

samir-docs: added SDK snippet and an inline note: "Masking is reversible only if customer-managed keys are enabled".

docs-bot: CI check — unit docs tests passed.

deploy-bot: Mergeable status: branch is mergeable; no conflicts.

elaine: Thanks everyone. Final asks before I merge: @legal_jane confirm wording okay, @security_ben confirm export/KMS sentence LGTM, @matt quick read on hosted wording. If no objections I'll merge in ~2 hours.

matt: LGTM from infra side. :thumbsup:

security_ben: LGTM for security (KMS bit included).

legal_jane: LGTM after replacing '<retention-window>' placeholders with actual values in the hosted section. We need to confirm numbers with compliance but go ahead and use 90/365 as examples (hosted default 90 days, max configurable 365).

elaine: replaced placeholders with 90 (hosted default) and noted max 365 in a parenthetical. I'll also add a follow-up TODO to sync with compliance for final numbers.

elaine: merging now. Thanks! :rocket:

docs-bot: PR #4123 merged by elaine — changelog updated.
